thread:
Asha (People Ops): welcome Zoe K! Quick security onboarding reminder: complete Security Basics training, enroll device in MDM, enable full-disk encryption, and set up 2FA by Friday. If you need a company device or phone, reply here and we'll coordinate.

Zoe K: thanks! I just got my laptop but saw a note about a phishing exercise. When is that and what happens if i click something?

Devon - InfoSec: Hi Zoe 44b phishing sim is next Tue 09:30 PT for recent joiners. If you fall for it, you'll get an automated coaching email and a ~10min follow-up module. No punitive action. We track completion per user for compliance reporting.

Zoe K: cool. also curious about MDM on personal phones. I use my phone for personal photos - will Redwood be able to access that?

Mobile IT: For BYOD phones we only apply a work profile (Android) or an MDM-managed cert and VPN (iOS). We do NOT access personal photos or apps. For company phones we enforce stronger controls including device encryption and remote wipe.

Alex R: FYI for macs: check FileVault with `fdesetup status`. For corp-laptops we require FileVault=On. For Windows corp devices BitLocker must be enabled.

Zoe K: how do i enable 2FA? I use phone SMS but heard we prefer a hardware key or app?

Devon - InfoSec: Strong preference for authenticator apps (Authenticator, 1Password built-in) or hardware keys (Yubikey). SMS is allowed temporarily but not recommended. Walkthrough: https://security.redwood.com/2fa-setup. If you want a YubiKey request via Asha.

Asha (People Ops): @Zoe K I can initiate a company phone request. Do you want a phone or just MDM BYOD?

Zoe K: i'll try BYOD first. If any issue, i'll ask for a swap.

security-bot: Course assigned -> Zoe K: "Security Basics" (id: 601). Due: 2026-04-02.

Devon - InfoSec: Quick note on remote wipe: for BYOD we support selective wipe of corporate data only. Full remote wipe is available only for company-assigned devices after approvals.

Alex R: also, if you need a VPN cert, enroll at https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll and then download the VPN profile from the console.

Zoe K: enrollment link 404 for me 628 tried SSO twice.

Mobile IT: Hey Zoe, can you DM your machine serial? We'll remote-provision.

Asha (People Ops): tagging @Devon to confirm training window for new hires. We want all new joiners completed within 1 week.

Devon - InfoSec: confirmed: new hire requirement = complete Security Basics + 2FA + MDM within 7 days. Phishing sim is part of ongoing program. If anything blocks you, escalate to Mobile IT or People Ops.

Zoe K: thanks all, DMing serial now. Appreciate the BYOD privacy details.
